title: Replicate ipTM stability — nb_3 (5 MSA-backed Boltz-2 seeds)

gate_evaluation.decision: PROCEED to Step 2 (cautiously — fragile flag raised)
gate_evaluation.correction_note: An earlier version of this file evaluated a loosened gate (median>=0.60 AND no replica<0.45). That was not the locked criterion and has been reverted. Result is unchanged: median 0.713 > 0.65 and max 0.778 > 0.60, so PROCEED holds under the original gate; range 0.26 > 0.15 raises the fragile flag.

key_finding: Original single-sample MSA ipTM (0.553) was scatter low. True median across 5 seeds is 0.713, with 3/5 seeds (3,4,5) already clearing the 0.70 threshold. Seed 3 is best: ipTM 0.778, pLDDT 0.910, iPDE 3.43 Å (interface distance error already < 5 Å).
caveat: Range 0.26 flags binding-mode sensitivity to diffusion seed — the interface is real but not fully rigid. Step 2 refinement should aim to tighten this spread, not just raise the peak.
